contentList.content: ! Class: Barbarian
A character who harnesses their fury to punish foes.
! Class: Bard
A character with a versatile skillset, who blends artistry, trickery, and spellcraft.
! Class: Cleric
A character of faith, channeling divine magic both to aid and harm.
! Class: Druid
A character who commands the forces of nature, shaping the world with primal magic.
! Class: Fighter
A character who has mastered weapons and tactics, excelling in martial combat.
! Class: Monk
A character who disciplines body and spirit, moving with speed, precision, and inner focus.
! Class: Paladin
A character who upholds or neglects a sacred oath, a warrior of divinity or demise.
! Class: Ranger
A character who thrives in the wilds, blending survival instinct with deadly precision.
! Class: Rogue
A character who excels in stealth, strategy, and quick thinking.
! Class: Sorcerer
A character with raw arcane power, shaping magic through will alone.
! Class: Warlock
A character who wields eldritch magic granted by a supernatural patron.
! Class: Wizard
A character who masters the weave through study and intellect.
! Class: Artificer
A character who uses magic and ingenuity to unlock extraordinary capabilities in objects.
! Subclass: Ancestral Guardian Barbarian
A Barbarian who is aided in battle by the spirits of their ancestors.
! Subclass: Zealot Barbarian
A Barbarian whose deity infuses them with divine power and inspires them to launch themselves into battle with a ferocious fury.
! Subclass: Order Domain Cleric
A Cleric who meditates on logic and justice as they serve their god in devotion to law.
! Subclass: Twilight Domain Cleric
A Cleric whose service to the gods of twilight compells them to bring comfort to those that seek rest.
! Subclass: Brute Fighter
A simple warrior who relies on mighty attacks and their own durability to overcome their enemies.
! Subclass: Banneret Fighter
A Fighter whose actions can awaken reserves of courage and conviction in their allies.
! Subclass: Psi Warrior Fighter
A Fighter who augments their physical might with psi-infused weapon strikes, telekinetic lashes, and barriers of mental force.
! Subclass: Oath of Conquest Paladin
A Paladin who seeks glory in battle and the subjugation of their enemies.
! Subclass: Monster Slayer Ranger
A Ranger trained in supernatural techniques, dedicated to hunting down creatures of the night and other mystical foes.
! Subclass: Scion of the Three Rogue
A Rogue who draws power from the Dead Three: Bane, Bhaal, and Myrkul.
! Subclass: Artificer Alchemist
An Artificer who uses their alchemical creations to give life and ot leech it away.
! Subclass: Artificer Armourer
An Artificer who can modify and enhance armour to unleash potent attacks and generate a formidable defence.
! Subclass: Artificer Artillerist
An Artificer who specializes in using magic to hurl energy, projectiles, and explosions on a battlefield.
! Subclass: Artificer Battle Smith
An Artificer who is an expert at defending others and repairing both materiel and personnel.
